intro: Maps and Runes is a Forsaken reconnaissance mission in Silverpine Forest. After discovering a suspicious shipment shipped toward Ambermill, adventurers recover a rune-inscribed pendant to deliver to Shadow Priest Allister at the Sepulcher for further investigation.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You quickly remove the pendant from the crate and replace the lid.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you learned anything useful, friend?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Maps and this... Pendant, hm? Interesting.
It is obvious that the Dalaran wizards are interested in Ambermill for some purpose, but still, their aim is hidden to me.
Perhaps Dalar will know something of their use.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
